nodes.label: CI workflow
nodes.rationale: Every action pinned to a full commit SHA so a moved tag cannot change what runs.

nodes.label: Qdrant keepalive workflow
nodes.rationale: Qdrant Cloud suspends a free cluster after a week without requests and deletes it after four; one read query twice a week keeps the index alive at no cost.

nodes.label: Secrets and configuration policy
nodes.rationale: Credentials live in env/SSM, CI uses OIDC; a leaked secret is rotated first, then history rewritten.

nodes.label: Retrieval and prompt change rules
nodes.rationale: Retrieval changes must attach precision@k/recall@k; dropping citations is a regression; reindexing is versioned and never overwrites a serving index.

nodes.label: F6 UI
nodes.rationale: Function URL carries no websockets, so Streamlit runs locally against the deployed API.

nodes.label: Cost first principle
nodes.rationale: Idle cost near $0; AWS runs only what must live there; free third-party tiers stay outside AWS.

nodes.label: Qdrant Cloud free tier vector store
nodes.rationale: Collection aliases switch the serving version atomically (promote-after-evaluation). Pinecone tried and dropped; OpenSearch serverless bills while idle.

nodes.label: Qdrant Cloud Inference embeddings (multilingual-e5-small)
nodes.rationale: Same model embeds at upsert and query so index and query never drift; no embedding host; handles Spanish and English.

nodes.label: Ollama Cloud LLM
nodes.rationale: Free plan and code already speaks Ollama API; fallback to DeepSeek if limits break 3 s p95, never both.

nodes.label: No OpenAI client / no provider zoo
nodes.rationale: No sentence-transformers so the image stays free of torch.

nodes.label: Shared MLflow server (portfolio-infra)
nodes.rationale: Keeps evaluation runs and index versions; not called per query to avoid AWS-to-GCP federation on the hot path.

nodes.label: Lazy clients
nodes.rationale: Clients built on first use so tests and Docker build stay green with no env vars.

nodes.label: Document RAG Assistant
nodes.rationale: Retrieve passages first and answer only from them with sources, to avoid uncited hallucinations.

nodes.label: Versioned index with alias promotion
nodes.rationale: Reindexing writes a new version; promote() moves the document-rag alias atomically only after evaluation passes.

nodes.label: Failure behaviour
nodes.rationale: Vector DB down -> 503 rather than uncited answers; low similarity -> 'not enough context'; LLM down -> return passages with error.

nodes.label: Deployment (Lambda container + Function URL)
nodes.rationale: Function URL gives HTTPS with no load balancer and no idle bill; reserved_concurrency caps spend.

nodes.label: AWS resources (Terraform)
nodes.rationale: No ALB, ECS or VPC so nothing is billed while idle.

nodes.label: SSM Parameter Store SecureString
nodes.rationale: Free unlike Secrets Manager; real credentials never sit in tfvars.

nodes.label: Local read-only Grafana
nodes.rationale: Read-only and costs nothing when stopped; alarms keep firing in CloudWatch.

hyperedges.label: Versioned index build, evaluation and alias promotion
